newsitem.title: USA: WMX named in shareholder lawsuit.
newsitem.headline: WMX named in shareholder lawsuit.

text.p: WMX Technologies Inc said on Thursday that it has received a shareholder lawsuit related to an adverse court judgment involving royalties to the former owners of its Emelle, Ala. operations.
WMX said it is studying the suit to determine its response and an appropriate course of action.
Also, WMX disagrees with the findings in the Emelle case and it plans to appeal the decision.

Separately, Moody's Investors Service said it downgraded the ratings of WMX's senior and subordinated debt due to the "erosion" of financial and debt-protection measurements resulting from acquisitions and ongoing share repurchases.
"Our ratings are still strong in keeping with the financial strength of our company," WMX spokesman William Plunkett said about the Moody's downgrade.
